notes.title: New Update Available
notes.notes:
Hello community

Hard Helmets have a new update ready, after several months of work, the final version of Hard Helmets is near and the new version of early access has many improvements to try.

Hard Helmets received a total change of 100% of their graphic style, which allows a greater fluidity in the computers of low level and superiors. In addition to the minimum system requirements are now lower.

MINIMUM:
OS: Windows XP, Vista, Windows 7 , Windows 8, Windows 10
Processor: Intel i3 or AMD equivalent
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: ATI or Nvidia Videocard with at least 256MB, or Intel GMA 950 or newer
DirectX: Version 9.0
Storage: 5 GB available space



The new war bonds are ready to be discovered, and from the Bonds Collector menu you will be able to know each one of the characteristics and abilities, as well as to know what war bonds you need to unlock.

The characters have new animations, more fluid and the response time of the controls is much faster.

The Hard Helmets development team has worked hard in recent months so that you can enjoy this game, we hope you continue to comment and collaborate on the development of helmets, we are in the final stages of its development and we will soon launch the final version of the game . steam game

Thank you community and do not forget to continue commenting and reporting errors that can be found in the game

We love

notes.title: Update V1.2
notes.notes:
Based on the comments of the community, we have worked the last week focusing on solving important problems of control and movement of the player characters, as they had strange behavior and late response control.
Those errors are now eliminated, the control now works in a more immediate and intuitive way.
In the course of this week will also include a new attack card for flamethrower and bombardment from the air

On the other hand we want to inform you that we are working on a next update that will include two new factions, and will also add the faction selection option before each game.
We thank all the players that have shown interest in Hard Helmets, and we remind you again that you can report any errors or let us know any suggestions or ideas to improve Hard Helmets, we are always attentive to the comments of the community and it is our goal to improve the I play with your help.
